# CurNext

> CurNext is a construction site intelligence platform that turns industrial IoT sensing into clear go / no-go readiness for concrete curing, wall drying and mold risk, indoor air quality, leak detection, structural health, and MEP.

CurNext helps contractors and consultants know when surfaces and systems are ready for the next construction phase, with continuous evidence rather than sparse spot checks.

## Primary product pages

- [Home](https://curnext.app/en): Platform overview of build-ready site intelligence
- [Solutions catalog](https://curnext.app/en/solutions): All CurNext monitoring solutions
- [Concrete curing monitoring (CN-CC)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/concrete-curing): Air, surface, and core probe monitoring for slab maturity and finish readiness
- [Wall drying and mold risk (CN-WD)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/wall-drying): Gypsum and wet-room drying readiness that helps reduce mold risk before finishes
- [Indoor air quality (CN-IAQ)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/indoor-air): CO2, PM, VOC, and climate monitoring during build and handover, including humidity context for mold risk
- [Leak detection (CN-LEAK)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/leak-detection): Event-driven water alerts for plant rooms, bathrooms, and risers
- [Structural health (CN-SHM)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/structural-health): Strain, crack, tilt, and vibration monitoring
- [MEP (CN-MEP)](https://curnext.app/en/solutions/mep): Flow, pressure, and energy monitoring on the same stack
- [How it works](https://curnext.app/en/how-it-works): L1-L5 architecture from field nodes to cloud
- [Pricing](https://curnext.app/en/pricing): Node and duration based commercial model
- [Security](https://curnext.app/en/security): Architecture and controls for site data
- [Documentation](https://curnext.app/en/docs): Product documentation
- [Knowledge Base](https://curnext.app/en/knowledge-base): Public product knowledge for support and discovery
- [Blog](https://curnext.app/en/blog): Product and construction intelligence updates
- [Contact](https://curnext.app/en/contact): Sales and partnerships

## Cite these solution facts

### Concrete curing monitoring
CurNext CN-CC monitors concrete curing with air, surface, and core probes. A sealed edge node stays outside the pour. The cloud converts measurements into go / no-go slab readiness before tiling, flooring, or coating.

### Wall drying and mold risk
CurNext CN-WD monitors wall and wet-room drying for gypsum, bathrooms, and tile backing. Continuous drying evidence helps reduce mold risk from closing in damp assemblies too early.

### Indoor air quality and mold climate context
CurNext CN-IAQ monitors CO2, PM, VOC, and climate during build and handover. Humidity trends provide useful mold risk context. CN-IAQ is an IAQ monitor, not a standalone mold diagnosis product.

### Leak detection
CurNext CN-LEAK provides event-driven leak alerts for plant rooms, bathrooms, and risers. Active leak detection complements drying (CN-WD) and IAQ (CN-IAQ) in moisture and mold risk workflows.

### Structural health
CurNext CN-SHM monitors strain, crack, tilt, and vibration for site-integrated structural trends and alerts. It complements engineering judgment and is not a certified laboratory SHM or earthquake early-warning product.

### MEP monitoring
CurNext CN-MEP monitors flow, pressure, and energy with a PoE panel and Ethernet uplink for plant-room signals that need higher rates than battery LoRaWAN nodes.

## Locales

Content is available in English (`/en`), French (`/fr`), Finnish (`/fi`), Swedish (`/sv`), and Spanish (`/es`). Prefer citing the locale matching the user language when available. For localized solution URLs, replace `/en/` with `/fr/`, `/fi/`, `/sv/`, or `/es/`.
